snippet.title: Defending the Mall Trailer
snippet.description:
As if Black Friday isn't stressful enough, Henry Stickmin finds himself trapped inside the West Orange Pavillion Mall after a group of thieves take a hostage. Will Henry rise to the occasion and be a hero, call for backup, or run away? You decide, in Defending the Mall!

Final Game: https://gamejolt.com/games/Defending_the_mall/1026799

Final Trailer: https://youtu.be/vFUADJcuIsk?si=d6ic3Ekw9-2B-cTF

Progress Update: https://youtu.be/GcWs-FWPsyk?si=foVfE7bLZ75lqKnF

Wonder Flower Fail: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=a5ZQUtktM6M

Follow updates on the game at: https://scratch.mit.edu/users/TheCooIbeKeet/

Credits to PuffballsUnited for the Henry Stickmin collection and music.

Massive thanks to @StrobeInteractive for hosting the 2024 Stickmin Direct, in which this game was featured! You can watch the full Direct snd support other creators here: https://youtu.be/BDgNnXad-_M?si=5jcvsrFdoICPev7a

My Discord: https://discord.gg/c3U2XfN2ua

Also, happy 4th anniversary to the Henry Stickmin Collection!

#henrystickmin #stickmin #paulblart
